cohort: A 29-year-old Asian woman, pregnant with her second child at 35 weeks gestation, with a history of gestational diabetes and previous cesarean section
finding: This case report describes a rare case of hemoperitoneum in a pregnant woman caused by spontaneous rupture of a uterine vein, highlighting the importance of immediate surgical intervention.
mod_finding: The patient underwent an emergency cesarean section due to fetal distress and suspected scar rupture, but the uterus was found to be intact.
